# A button used as a navigation link still exposes aria-pressed

Please comment to claim before starting. Check the current assignee and linked pull requests first.

## Context

While reviewing #21058 I found the same role mismatch in the ordinary button on current `dev`. #21016 owns `Neo.button.Effect`. This issue covers `Neo.button.Base`, whose toggle semantics shipped in #20833.

## The Problem

A pressed button can become a navigation link when its `url` changes. On Engine `ce985e885276772b17d4fd6f2f4c5161dbf1a3ca` I instantiated `Neo.button.Base` with `{text: 'Details', pressed: true}`, set `button.url = '#details'`, then cleared it. The rendered VDOM roots were:

| Step | Root | `aria-pressed` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Initial | native button | `"true"` |
| URL set | `<a href="#details">` with the implicit link role | `"true"` |
| URL cleared | native button | `"true"` |

A native hyperlink should keep its navigation semantics. WAI-ARIA assigns this pressed state to the button role. This reproduction inspected component VDOM. [Specification](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-pressed)

## The Architectural Reality

`afterSetPressed` projects the attribute for toggles. `updateTag` changes between button and anchor when navigation config changes. Both affect which accessible state the actual element may expose. Tab headers already have their own selection semantics. [Pressed-state writer](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ce985e885276772b17d4fd6f2f4c5161dbf1a3ca/src/button/Base.mjs#L385) · [Tag writer](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ce985e885276772b17d4fd6f2f4c5161dbf1a3ca/src/button/Base.mjs#L717)

## The Fix

Keep the ARIA projection consistent with the rendered role when either the pressed state or the tag changes. Preserve the visual pressed class and native navigation. Add a focused regression alongside the existing button tests.

| Surface | Required behavior | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Native button | Omit `aria-pressed` for a plain button. For Boolean toggles report `"false"` or `"true"`. | Existing toggle controls |
| Ordinary hyperlink | Omit `aria-pressed` regardless of the stored pressed value. Keep the `href` and link behavior. | URL or route configured at creation, plus a live tag transition |
| Link back to button | Restore the ARIA value appropriate to the current config even when `pressed` did not change during the transition. | Button → link → button regression |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A native link with a Boolean pressed config exposes no `aria-pressed` on initial rendering or when `pressed` changes while it remains a link.
- [ ] Setting and clearing a URL on an existing toggle changes the exposed ARIA state with the role in both directions. A native plain button keeps the attribute absent.
- [ ] Existing button and tab tests stay green. Run `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/button/ test/playwright/unit/tab/`.

## Out of Scope

The separate Effect implementation and its #21058 review, existing navigation behavior, new keyboard semantics, and changing which outside PR lands.
